comment: Model answers the cleanup pass keeps or rejects, and the dictionary hint it sends, with desktop's answers (ios/prd.json IOS-007, IOS-030). Desktop writes every validate answer itself (MURMUR_WRITE_VECTORS=1 npx vitest run src/main/formatter/polish-vectors.test.ts). Every platform runs these: validate gives input, the model's candidate answer, and whether smart lists and apply corrections are on, then ok with the text kept, or the reason it was rejected; hints gives dictionary entries and the hint line, or null for none.
